title: Binance Completes the Open Campus Subscription Launchpad and Will Open Trading for EDU
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance has completed the subscription format Launchpad for Open Campus and the final token allocation results are now showing on the  Open Campus Launchpad Page . Binance will list Open Campus (EDU) in the innovation zone and open trading for EDU/BTC, EDU/USDT, EDU/TUSD and EDU/BNB trading pairs at  2023-04-28 12:00 (UTC) . Users will enjoy  zero maker fees  on the  EDU/TUSD  trading pair until further notice. A total of 120,292 participants committed 9,088,202.4116  BNB during the subscription period, representing an oversubscription of 1,189x.  4 participants reached the 300,000 EDU hard cap, resulting in the participants’ allocation being passed down to the remaining users. For further information on how this is calculated, refer to a detailed guide  here . As a reference for users that participated: Users that committed 50 BNB received an allocation of 277.3028 EDU and will have 0.04237464 BNB deducted. Users that committed 500 BNB received an allocation of 2,773.0279 EDU, and will have 0.42374639 BNB deducted. Users that committed 5,000 BNB received an allocation of 27,730.2790 EDU and will have 4.23746390 BNB deducted. The corresponding BNB tokens will be deducted from your already-locked BNB balance within 60 minutes of this announcement. Once deducted, your EDU and remaining BNB tokens will both be transferred to your spot wallet. Note: The token purchase price was set at 1 EDU = 0.00015281 BNB or 0.05 USD (using a BNB price of 327.2 USD), as per the previous announcement  here .
